title: New Business Executive
description:
Sales Executive

Offices: Bromsgrove

Up to £40 K base plus bonus around £5 K uncapped

Job Role

You will be responsible for initiating contact with potential clients, nurturing prospects, and setting up appointments for the sales team. This role requires a confident communicator who can leverage forms of business communication via telephone, email, LinkedIn, video calls, messaging platforms, and CRM tools to generate interest in our services and convert cold leads into warm opportunities.

To conduct outbound calls to potential clients across target industries. Use LinkedIn and other professional networks to identify, engage, and qualify prospects. Write compelling outreach emails and follow ups to initiate conversations and promote the company.

Conduct outbound calls to potential clients across target industries (e.g., B2 B brands, marketing agencies, event organizers).

Utilize CRM software to manage leads, track interactions, and update contact records with detailed notes.

Conduct virtual discovery calls when necessary to qualify leads before passing to the sales team.

Follow up on inbound inquiries.

Maintain a consistent volume of outreach activity while meeting or exceeding targets for leads .

Attend occasional industry events, trade shows, or virtual expos to assist with live lead generation.

The successful candidate will be a strong and confident communicator and must be prepared to approach and/or talk to people they have not met before to engage them in discussion.

title: Sales Development Representative
company: Jonathan Lee Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
The Opportunity

Are you confident, target-driven and passionate about building relationships? This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated Business Development Executive to generate new sales opportunities, connect with key decision-makers and support account managers in driving business growth within a B2 B environment.

You ll play a key role in developing the sales pipeline through proactive outreach, engaging conversations and effective appointment setting, with clear targets and opportunities to develop your commercial skills.

- Identify key decision-makers, develop new contacts and generate quality sales opportunities.

- Understand the company's services and communicate their value effectively.
- Maintain accurate CRM records, customer information and activity reports.
- Work towards KPIs and sales targets, focusing on contact rates, meeting generation and return on investment.
- Produce professional and accurate customer correspondence.
- Manage your time effectively, prioritise workloads and maintain consistent sales activity.
- Participate in training and coaching to continually improve sales performance.
- Collaborate with colleagues while taking ownership of individual targets and responsibilities.

About You
- At least two years' experience in a similar B2 B role; three to five years' experience would be advantageous.
- Confident communicator with strong relationship-building and listening skills.
- Proactive, organised and motivated by targets and measurable results.
- Comfortable with telephone and email-based prospecting and appointment setting.
- Competent in Microsoft Office and CRM systems.
- Able to work independently while contributing positively to a team.
- Reliable, professional and receptive to feedback, training and development.

If you enjoy connecting with people, creating new opportunities and achieving results, this is an opportunity to build your career in business development and make a real contribution to sales growth.

title: Contact Centre Manager
description:
Contact Centre Manager

38-42k, Office based

Their customer contact centre is at the heart of how customers experience our client, from their first question to their finished product. We're looking for a hands-on leader to run it, raise the bar on service and sales, and make the most of AI and our digital channels.

The role

You'll lead a multi-channel contact centre of around 14 people across phone, live chat, text and email, reporting to our Director of Customer Experience. Leading a team of Supervisors, you'll own service levels, sales conversion, customer satisfaction and the day-to-day running of the team.

This is a role for someone who leads from the floor, knows their numbers, and is excited by what AI can do for customers and advisors. You'll have real influence over how we work, the tools we use and how we develop our people.

What you'll do
- Lead, coach and develop Supervisors and their teams
- Own answer rates, chat response times, quality and customer satisfaction
- Drive sales conversion and run our advisor commission scheme
- Act as the senior escalation point for complaints and difficult cases
- Plan rotas and staffing for seasonal peaks
- Run a quality framework covering call and chat monitoring, coaching and feedback
- Manage our 8x 8 contact centre platform, including queues, routing, wallboards and reporting
- Lead our use of AI in the contact centre, from our AI chat advisor to agent assist and automated quality checks, making sure it improves the customer experience
- Report on performance and turn data into clear actions
- Work with delivery, installation, quality and marketing teams to fix the reasons customers need to contact us

What you'll bring
- Experience managing a contact centre team of 10 or more, including supervisors or team leaders
- A track record in both sales and service
- Confidence running a team on KPIs and workforce planning
- A fair, firm approach to people management
- Experience of 8x 8 or a similar cloud contact centre platform
- Hands-on experience of AI in a customer contact setting, such as chatbots or virtual agents, agent assist, automated quality monitoring or AI-driven reporting, and the curiosity to find new ways AI can improve the customer experience and free advisors up for higher-value conversations
- Strong reporting and Excel skills

It would be great if you also have
- Experience implementing or improving an AI chatbot or virtual agent
- A background in e-commerce or high-value consumer products
- Working knowledge of UK consumer rights

title: Key Account Executive
salary_text: £40000 - £45000 per year (Up to £45,000 depending on experienc)
description:
Key Account Executive Redditch Up to £45,000 depending on experience Engineering & Manufacturing
Do you enjoy the engineering conversation just as much as the commercial one?
Perhaps you're already managing technical accounts, but you'd like more involvement in the engineering side. Or maybe you're technically minded, understand manufacturing and have discovered you're pretty good at building customer relationships too.
As Key Account Executive, you'll get to do both.
You'll be talking to engineers about drawings, specifications and what they're trying to achieve, then turning those conversations into commercially sound solutions and long-term customer relationships.
And you won't be selling something from a catalogue.
The business has been manufacturing engineered components for more than 60 years, supplying customers across Aerospace, Defence, Energy, Medical and High-Tech sectors.
The conversations here are about solving problems, understanding applications and finding the right way to manufacture something.
As Key Account Executive, you'll take ownership of a portfolio of established, high-value accounts, building on relationships that are already there while finding opportunities to grow them.
There's also a business development element to the Key Account Executive position. You'll be looking beyond your existing customers, identifying new opportunities and building relationships with businesses that could benefit from what you have to offer.
Some days that means sitting down with a customer's engineering team to understand a new requirement.
Other days you might be reviewing a drawing, preparing a quotation, supporting an NPI project or spotting another area where you can help.
You'll become the person your customers call because you understand both sides of the conversation.
That's an important part of being a Key Account Executive here.
You're not simply passing enquiries from customers to engineering and waiting for an answer. You'll have enough engineering knowledge to ask good questions, challenge where needed and help shape a solution that works technically and commercially.
Internally, you'll work closely with Production, Quality, Engineering and Supply Chain. There's no point promising something that can't be delivered, so communication matters.
You'll understand what the customer needs, what the business can achieve and bring the two together.
As Key Account Executive, you'll also get out and see your customers. There'll be customer visits, reviews, exhibitions and industry events, giving you the opportunity to build relationships beyond emails and Teams calls.
So, what do you need to bring?
You'll need to be technically minded, with a good understanding of mechanical engineering or manufacturing. That might come from an HNC, HND, degree or simply years of experience working in a technical environment.
You'll already have worked in technical sales, account management or sales engineering within manufacturing, and you'll be comfortable interpreting engineering drawings and specifications.
Experience within Aerospace, Defence, Energy or other highly regulated manufacturing environments would be beneficial.
But the important combination is technical curiosity and commercial awareness.
You're someone who wants to understand why.
Why does the customer need it? Could it be engineered differently? Is there another opportunity within the account? What other businesses could benefit from the same engineering expertise?
And how do you make sure the solution works for the customer and makes commercial sense for the business?
If that's how you naturally think, you'll probably enjoy being a Key Account Executive here.
You'll be credible with customers, comfortable negotiating and organised enough to keep your CRM, forecasts and pipeline up to date.
And what's in it for you?
You'll earn up to £45,000 depending on experience, joining an established engineering manufacturer with over 60 years of experience and ambitions to keep growing.
Alongside your salary, you'll receive:
- 25 days' holiday, with an additional 2 days based on attendance.
- Stakeholder pension with 5% employee and 3% employer contributions.
- Life insurance worth twice your annual salary.
- Company sick pay.
- Employee Assistance Programme.
- Company-funded social events.
- Cycle to Work scheme.

But there's also the opportunity to have a genuine influence on where the business grows next.
This isn't about inheriting some accounts and simply keeping them ticking over.
As Key Account Executive, you'll have the opportunity to build on existing partnerships, develop new customer relationships and see the difference your work makes to the business.
If you're technically minded, enjoy building relationships and can hold your own in both an engineering and commercial conversation, this could be worth a chat.
